ADDENDUM (2026-10-19): the game now runs this. factor_id names each row for the code. Scoring is ADDITIVE per event, on main-story (writ) chapters only: a deed earned = writ_deed (2); a delivery, solo hold or dispersal deed also = legible (1.5); a kill = raw_kill (0.5) if made within the surveyor radius, else unwitnessed_kill (0); finishing a map's stated objective (seizing, escaping, escorting, felling the boss of a defend map) = on_objective (1); ANY of those done within the surveyor radius also earns witnessed (1). The surveyor stands at the camp -- the middle of the deploy row -- since far-corner heroics 'do not appear in the report'. Paralogue deeds score paralogue_deed (0). literacy is added (not stored) once a support of Ricberta's has revealed it (supports.reveals / reveals_at_rank). The writ scene is ch_x11 (the Second Writ): the crown's pick is the highest score; the player may name another, once; the crown grants it and withholds Column B's supply attachment (drafted as gold: prm_column_b_supply_gold on each Column B chapter won). Highest score wins ties by canonical order.
